standard_prerequisites.use: Realises the inertia through the stabilizer of a presentation in the converse direction.

core_obligations: (1) implies (2): pass to a flat finitely presented base change that presents the stack as a quotient by a group acting on a scheme, note that the base change is still a gerbe, compute the inertia of the quotient as the acting group, which is flat and locally of finite presentation, and descend these properties back (proof lines 6328-6366)

(2) implies (1): present the stack by a smooth groupoid, observe that the flatness and finite presentation of the inertia make the stabilizer group space flat and locally of finite presentation over the presentation, and use the gerbe criterion for a stack to conclude that the stack is a gerbe over the quotient of the presentation by the stabilizer (proof lines 6367-6425)
proof_roadmap: (1)⇒(2)：取平坦有限表现基变换 X' → X 把 X' 写成 [U/G]（本地结构引理），仍为 gerbe；惯性在基变换下按纤维积变化 ⇒ 可下降到 X；而 [U/G] 的惯性就是 G，由 gerbe-with-section 知 G 平坦且局部有限表现。
(2)⇒(1)：取光滑展示 X = [U/R]，其稳定子群空间 G → U 就是惯性沿 U 的拉回 ⇒ G 平坦且局部有限表现；再由「何时是 gerbe」的判据（稳定子群的平坦性）得 X 是 U 上商栈的 gerbe。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement is the author's proposition characterizing when an algebraic stack is a gerbe over an algebraic space by flatness and local finite presentation of its inertia (source lines 6318-6326, label proposition-when-gerbe); the author's own proof at source lines 6328-6426 follows it immediately and is its proof. The forward direction passes to a flat finitely presented base change presenting the stack as a quotient by a group, computes the inertia as that group and descends; the converse realises the inertia through the stabilizer of a smooth presentation and applies the gerbe criterion (proof lines 6328-6425). The two reductions and the identification of the inertia with the acting or stabilizer group are the substance. H3.
